lines: lin
完整保留。再核实当时在场的人。
Preserve the full sequence. Verify who else was there.
segments.label: 9月2日 · 店内事件回溯

lines: lu
她自己走出去的。第二天才摔倒。
She walked out on her own. She didn't fall until the next day.
lin
我问的是，你在店里对她做了什么。
I'm asking what you did to her in the shop.
segments.label: 讯问室 · 核对录像所见

lines: xu
还能走路，不能排除血管损伤。严重后果可能晚些才出现。
Being able to walk doesn't rule out vascular injury. Serious effects can develop later.
jian
但这次是不是这样，要靠她自己的资料。
But we must establish what happened in her case from her own records.
segments.label: 法医复核 · 结合个案资料

lines: zhou
完整急救录音已经申请。还得核对，是先异常，还是先跌倒。
We've requested the full emergency call. We need to establish whether the symptoms preceded the fall.
lin
找到打电话的人，分别问。
Find the caller and interview them independently.
segments.label: 调查组 · 核实先后顺序

lines: zhou
检刺……你的牙？
Jian Ci... your teeth?
jian
别靠近。我先出去。
Don't come closer. I'm stepping out.
xu
刚才，你是想咬人吗？
Were you about to bite someone?
jian
是。我停住了。但不能说下一次也一定行。
Yes. I stopped myself. But I can't promise I always will.
segments.label: 隔壁休息室 · 片刻后

lines: xu
你先停工。这件事要告诉韩队。
Stop working for now. Captain Han needs to know.
jian
我受过一次重伤。醒来时，在一间旧诊所。伤口很快好了，却开始渴望血。
I was badly injured once. I woke in an old clinic. My wounds healed quickly, but I began craving blood.
xu
以前伤过人吗？
Have you hurt anyone before?
jian
咬伤过救我的人。她叫阿宁。
I bit the person who saved me. Her name was A-Ning.
